description.fun: Terrakion has phenomenal strength: its charge can break through a giant castle wall in a single blow, and it will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon. In Unovan legend it fought humans alongside Cobalion and Virizion to protect Pokémon who had lost their homes in a war, shaping the earth to open an escape route. It's the trio's Porthos: the biggest and strongest, with horns modelled on axes.
description.guide: Terrakion is a Rock- and Fighting-type Legendary Pokémon and one of the Swords of Justice. Legends say its charge could break through a castle wall. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A castle-smashing protector of small Pokémon.
